messages:
Ravi: Posted the postmortem for the KV-cache instability: https://notion.redwood/pm/kv-cache-2024. Root cause: synchronized evictions + delayed fallback decision. Need clear runbook updates.
IncidentBot: Postmortem created by Ravi. Please add remediation owners and timelines.
Neha: I'll take runbook edits. Goal: make triage actions actionable for the first 7 minutes (what to check, exact commands to run, and what safe signals look like).
Jules: I'll draft a 'first-7-min' checklist and a tiny wrapper for triggering fallback that does a preflight and uses a lock.
Maya: Reminder: last forced fallback caused a cold-pool latency spike. We need a preflight with capacity and error-rate checks before triggering.
Sam: Proposed owners: Runbook PR -> Neha; Checklist + wrapper script -> Jules; Preflight queries + Grafana panel -> Maya; Rollout coordination + tracker -> Sam.
Neha: putting tentative due dates: runbook PR by 2024-07-10, checklist/script by 2024-07-08, safety validation by 2024-07-09.
Ravi: escalation ladder to include: 1) page eng-oncall (pagerduty) 2) if no ack in 4m escalate to eng-sre 3) if error rate > 5% or latency > 300ms for 10m -> page infra-leads. Also add regional carve-outs for APAC.
Jules: pasting draft commands for the runbook so they can be copy/pasted:
```
# check cache memory + evictions
kubectl -n inference exec svc/cache-inspector -- redis-cli INFO memory | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'
# check cache hitrate metric (promql)
rate(cache_hits_total[1m]) / rate(cache_requests_total[1m])
# trigger graceful fallback (wrapper will run preflight)
curl -X POST https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks/trigger -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"mode":"graceful"}'
```
Maya: I'll create the Grafana panel and add the exact PromQL used for the preflight (spare capacity >10% and 1m error rate <1%). Will link panel to runbook.
Neha: I'll include an explicit 'what to expect' blurb for oncall so they know the likely transient effects of the fallback. Also adding a quick rollback step.
Sam: let's add a recurring quarterly playbook audit for cache incidents. Tagging 'recurring-incidents' on the backlog.
IncidentBot: Check-in meeting created for 2024-07-15 11:00 (invite sent). Reminder will be posted 2 days prior.
Jules: I'll open the PR for checklist + wrapper later today and link it here.
Maya: will run the safety tests in staging and post results before the check-in.
Neha: once PRs are green I'll assign reviewers and update the tracker. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks everyone. Aim to close these remediation items in two sprints.
